name: Milk Tea Making Task State
description: State variables the intent monitor LLM must track from video frames. Models the 'boiled milk' (doodh-patti) style milk tea seen in the Ego-Exo4D 'Making Milk Tea' takes: milk is the boiling base, tea and sugar go into the pot, and the brewed tea is strained through a sieve into the mug.

current_phase.description: Current high-level phase of the task

current_action.description: Specific action currently being performed (must match a DAG node id)

human_state.description: Current activity of the human operator

milk_in_pot.description: Milk has been poured into the saucepan

water_added.description: Water has been added to the saucepan (optional)

stove_on.description: Gas stove is lit (open flame under the saucepan)

milk_boiling.description: Milk is boiling (steam, frothing or bubbles visible)

tea_added.description: Tea leaves or tea bag have been added to the pot

sugar_added.description: Sugar has been added to the pot (if requested)

tea_simmered.description: Tea has simmered / steeped long enough to be brewed

stove_off.description: Stove has been turned off after brewing

tea_strained.description: Brewed tea has been strained through the sieve into the mug

predicted_next_action.description: Predicted next action based on task graph (shares valid_values with current_action)

prediction_confidence.description: Confidence in the predicted next action (0-1)

robot_state.description: Robot execution status (populated from robot API, not vision)

robot_active_program.description: Current robot program/action id when busy (populated from robot API, not vision)

robot_engagement.description: Vision-informed judgement from the intent monitor on whether the robot should continue its actions now. 'continue' = safe to proceed with scheduled actions; 'hold' = defer all non-safety robot activity. The BT gates deterministic action branches on this being 'continue'.
